subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e reproduzir, em verbetes de enciclopédia infantil, digitais ou impressos, a formatação e diagramação específica desse gênero (título do verbete, definição, detalhamento, curiosidades), considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar convenções de formatação e layout específicas de verbetes de enciclopédia infantil
components.description_en: Identify the formatting and layout conventions specific to children's encyclopedia entries
components.cc_component_description: Incorporate formatting such as headings to structure an informational text

components.description_pt: Reconhecer componentes estruturais de verbete de enciclopédia: título, definição, elaboração e curiosidades
components.description_en: Recognize the structural components of an encyclopedia entry: title, definition, elaboration, and curiosities
components.cc_component_description: Explain the structural relationship between individual text components and the whole text

components.description_pt: Ler verbetes de enciclopédia infantil considerando propósito comunicativo e tema
components.description_en: Read children's encyclopedia entries considering their communicative purpose and topic
components.cc_component_description: Identify characteristics of various text types and their communicative purposes

components.description_pt: Reproduzir formato e layout de verbetes de enciclopédia infantil em produção escrita
components.description_en: Reproduce the format and layout of children's encyclopedia entries in written production
components.cc_component_description: Apply formal style conventions in a written argument

cc_matches.description: Analyze how a particular sentence, paragraph, chapter, or section fits into the overall structure of a text and contributes to the development of the ideas.

Introduce a topic; organize ideas, concepts, and information, using strategies such as definition, classification, comparison/contrast, and cause/effect; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.

Multilingual learners will construct language arts arguments that
* Introduce and develop a topic clearly; state an opinion 
* Support opinions with reasons and information 
* Use a formal style 
* Logically connect opinions to appropriate evidence, facts, and details; offer a concluding statement or section

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar explicaciones para...
* presentar o definir temas
* describir cómo funciona u ocurre algo
* agregar precisión y detalles
* exponer las características de textos y sus propósitos
* relacionar diferencias en una variedad de textos
